label: Inspired playful attentiveness to fleeting particulars and unconventional taxonomy
description: Classical Chinese Daoist sensibility—especially Zhuangzi's delight in spontaneous transformation and unexpected perspectives—resonates throughout Sei Shōnagon's zuihitsu lists in The Pillow Book.
dialecticalTension: Transposes Daoist wandering spontaneity into Heian urban aesthetic perception.
historicalContext: Sino-Japanese literary canon circulating in the Heian imperial court.
